_meta.coverage_metric: profile source-identity honesty, edition immutability, Human-owned terminology and compliance boundaries, ruleset binding, profile optionality, and uncommitted official bytes; deterministic tokenization and word budgets; calibrated-heuristic admission and composition; source-node preservation for structured XML; extraction-quality declaration; privacy class to execution lane routing; exact profile/termbase/source/candidate evidence binding; corpus-recomputed calibration; integrated A/B experiment validity and outcome gates; authority-bound A/B composition
_meta.purpose: Prove that a proposal-derived controlled-language profile cannot present itself as an official standard edition, cannot bind a ruleset it does not have, cannot become a mandatory core dependency, cannot relax deterministic, privacy, or Human Admit boundaries, and cannot use primitive mechanism success as a proxy for exact profile-conformance evidence.

runnable.hollow_fixture: selftest mutations promoting the proposal to an official edition, making the edition mutable, relaxing terminology or compliance admit, drifting the ruleset, removing the profile-absent state, dropping a trigger boundary, widening privacy, or committing standard bytes
covers: a SOURCE_PROPOSAL pack cannot name an official standard designation in its edition, display name, pack id, or authority
an edition must name one immutable revision
an OFFICIAL_STANDARD pack needs a resolvable locator and a decided license classification
VENDORED content requires an admitted redistribution grant
technical name and verb admission stay Human-owned and compliance stays HUMAN_ADMIT_REQUIRED
ruleset_digest binds the ruleset actually present, and its provenance matches the pack
the core keeps a PROFILE_ABSENT state and every profile module states its trigger boundary
no standard or vocabulary artifact is committed without an admitted grant
runnable.expected: canonical pack admitted; each of the 15 planted mutations refused with a distinct reason

runnable.good_fixture: inline sentences exercising each stated tokenization rule
runnable.hollow_fixture: mutations that split hyphenated compounds, count punctuation as words, digest a re-rendering instead of the exact substring, stop collapsing admitted multiword terms, or end a sentence on an abbreviation
covers: a hyphenated compound, a quoted span, and an admitted multiword term each count as one word
punctuation-only tokens are not words and internal punctuation is kept
an abbreviation's period does not end a sentence
a source span digest binds the exact substring of the exact subject
an over-budget sentence is an ERROR and an in-budget one is silent
the CLI exits 2 on an over-budget document and 64 on an absent subject, so a checker error is not read as a document failure
runnable.expected: selftest green; each planted tokenization or span defect turns it red

runnable.good_fixture: a calibration receipt with a pinned implementation, a measured corpus, both error rates, and a ceiling
runnable.hollow_fixture: mutations making the implementation version mutable, emptying the corpus, exercising zero cases, omitting one error direction, exceeding the ceiling, self-admitting the threshold, or letting a heuristic conclude or override
covers: a heuristic needs a pinned implementation identity and digest, not a mutable version
an empty corpus or zero exercised cases is an absent measurement, not a calibrated one
both false-positive and false-negative rates are required
measured error may not exceed the declared ceiling and the threshold is Human-admitted
a heuristic cannot produce a final PASS on its own
a heuristic PASS cannot hide a deterministic FAIL, and an errored evaluator is not a passing one
runnable.expected: selftest green; all 14 planted admission and composition defects refused

runnable.good_fixture: an S1000D-like and a DITA-like fixture, plus a faithful rewrite that changes prose inside preserved nodes
runnable.hollow_fixture: outputs that are well-formed XML but drop a warning or caution, reorder steps while keeping the same text, drop an identifier or cross-reference, remove a step, or are malformed; format declarations that trigger on the wrong content; extractions with undeclared or contradictory quality
covers: a dropped safety node is refused even when the output is well-formed
reordered steps with unchanged text are reported separately from removal
identifiers and cross-reference targets survive a rewrite
a structured-XML module cannot trigger on plain text and a text module cannot trigger on XML
extraction quality must be declared, and PARTIAL or GARBLED blocks semantic PASS
a structure reported as unrecovered contradicts a COMPLETE extraction
runnable.expected: faithful rewrites preserved; 19 planted preservation, trigger and extraction defects refused; CLI exits 2 on a lossy rewrite and 64 on an absent file

runnable.good_fixture: every privacy class routed at its own ceiling, including CONFIDENTIAL external with a matching human approval
runnable.hollow_fixture: RESTRICTED routed off-box or with network enabled, INTERNAL sent externally, CONFIDENTIAL external without approval or approved by an agent or for a different subject, a provider healthy but unadmitted, a provider admitted but unhealthy, secrets or machine paths in a durable receipt, an undeclared fallback
covers: RESTRICTED always routes LOCAL_ONLY with network disabled
a class may be processed more privately than its ceiling but never less
CONFIDENTIAL external processing needs a human approval bound to the same document digest
provider health and privacy admission are separate states and neither substitutes for the other
an admitted but unhealthy provider blocks rather than falling back to an unadmitted lane
durable receipts carry no token, session, key or machine path, and a fallback must be declared
runnable.expected: every class routable at its ceiling; 16 planted routing defects refused
